			local best, bestCost
items.what: Laps (Model.lua:2834-2853) repeats Build's finishing pass (Model.lua:1639-1646 describe/opens and 1677-1693 'town point = spot nearest the stop before, areas Enter, Locate, advance from') almost line for line. Canonical: one Finish(data, player, completed, log, steps, from, docks, mapName) used by both.
items.why: The nearest-giver loop (CostTo(from, Point(...)) over step.spots) is identical in both. Differences: Laps also calls Tell on areas and skips Enter for a `here` area, and falls back `or from` when Position is nil; Build runs Describe/Opens before ordering.
